BREAKING: US oil prices have recorded 3 drawdowns of at least 20% so far in 2026, matching their # such streak since the 1980s.

2020 was the only year with a longer streak, at 4 such declines, while 1990, 1991, 1998, and 2022 each recorded 3.

Taking intraday prices into account, US oil prices have posted 4 drawdowns of at least 20% this year.

Furthermore, oil prices have seen 8 corrections of 10%+ so far in 2026, their longest such streak since 1986.

The same number of 10%+ drawdowns was posted in 1990, 2004, and 2009.

Year-to-date, oil prices are up +42%, on track for the largest annual gain since 2021.

US oil prices have rarely been this volatile.

Testing the Trend Template as though it were a complete strategy is like asking a hammer to build a house, or asking a race car chassis to win a race.

Many believe the # stock rally is primarily driven by Tech and AI. But this bull market is actually far broader than commonly envisioned. Yes, there is excess AI hype. But a bubble? America’s S&P 500 is 35.7% Tech by market cap. Tech-like firms add another 11.2%. MSCI’s World Ex-USA Index is less than 10% Tech and Tech-like. Yet the two are not far apart year to date.

To see this bull market’s real and massive breadth, employ basic logic tests. The AI trade centers on Tech, classic growth stocks. Yet through Friday, Russell’s 1000 Growth Index is down 13.3% in 2026. The 1000 Value? Up 16.1%. The Russell 2000 Value index trounces its growth counterpart, 8.4% to -2.1%. This market is value-led.
